mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.script_id, c.title, c.synopsis, NULL AS raw_content, NULL AS structure_json, CHAR_LENGTH(c.raw_content) AS raw_content_length, c.source_type, c.parse_status, c.structure_version, c.last_error, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_by, c.updated_by FROM manga_project_script_chapter c WHERE c.script_id = #{scriptId} ORDER BY c.sort_order, c.id

SELECT c.id, c.script_id, c.title, c.synopsis, c.raw_content, c.structure_json, c.source_type, c.parse_status, c.structure_version, c.last_error, c.sort_order, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.created_by, c.updated_by FROM manga_project_script_chapter c WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND c.script_id = #{scriptId}
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_project_script_chapter SET title = #{chapter.title}, synopsis = #{chapter.synopsis}, raw_content = #{chapter.rawContent}, structure_json = #{chapter.structureJson}, source_type = #{chapter.sourceType}, parse_status = #{chapter.parseStatus}, structure_version = #{chapter.structureVersion}, last_error = #{chapter.lastError}, sort_order = #{chapter.sortOrder}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{chapter.updatedBy} WHERE id = #{chapter.id} AND script_id = #{chapter.scriptId}
